description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -  Mahaloluwa, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District  - Cad. Map No. 511001
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners' names and addresses, nature of title, and any encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
